Name: Sober
Notes: ROUND AN - THE DRUNK METER (Anthony, 8 Oct: in the pub, when a player drinks, their drunk meter reaches certain levels that give them special treatment). FROM is the % on the meter where this level starts; the rows can be in any order and the highest one he has reached is his level. Sober: nothing poured takes hold - no elemental brew, no inspirational brew.

Name: Tipsy
Notes: BREWS: from here the elemental brews (an Element in Brews.csv, the turning beers too) and the inspirational ones (any brew that gives an ability) take hold. Below this the Pub will not pour them, and one already poured does nothing in the match. DRAFT number - yours to change.

Name: Inspired
Notes: STAR: he plays as a Star - the badge, and the star ability baked in by his Tier and Power (StarAbilities.csv; for now every row is Koch's Beer Courage). TURN_DRINKS:-2: a Star needs two fewer turning beers to change for good (3 becomes 1), which is how Koch turns into the Bergmannlein with one Earth Brew in the Tutorial. DRAFT numbers.
